decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) an early multi-sample drop and partial rebound in N/E (365–544) with no clear U counterpart, and (2) a deepening E trend with an abrupt multi-sample shift and ambiguous recovery (605–729). Both show superposed or unresolved cross-axis behavior.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape shows a multi-sample drop in N and E around index 380–385, followed by a prolonged low-amplitude platform (N ~ -1.5 to -2.5, E ~ -0.5 to 0.5) until ~index 460; then a sharp multi-sample rebound in N (~+2.5) at index 461–462, possibly opposing the earlier drop but not fully recovering. U shows no clear counterpart, suggesting possible superposed motion or local artifact.

From index ~620 onward, E exhibits a sustained deepening trend (E < -7, down to ~-13.8 at index 672), with N also trending negative but less steeply; U fluctuates moderately. A notable abrupt multi-sample shift occurs around index 665–667 (E jumps from ~-7.5 to ~-10.6), followed by a partial recovery in E (~-8.5) by index 675—ambiguous whether this is a temporary offset or part of ongoing deformation. The region includes missing samples at 668–669 and 672, complicating return assessment.
